Springfield Fall 2026 swim lessons open Tuesday, September 15 at 7:00 a.m. Since your postal code is a Springfield resident one, you get in first, and the general public opens 7 days later. Max fits the published age band for this session. Mia is just outside it, so please check it fits her before you sign off. Registration is here: https://rec.example.org/springfield/fall-2026

If you approve, I'll text you a week ahead, a checklist three days before, a reminder the evening before, and a heads-up 15 minutes before it opens. I can't register for you, though; you'll do that yourself on the site.

Once you've picked a course, send me its link and I'll put it in the morning text.
